proposed_widenings.name: subclass_grant
proposed_widenings.justification: Subclass selection is a one-time character-progression gate with no activation cost, no resource, no rest reset, and no combat-relevant effect. The existing class_feature/activation family requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence + effect (grant_extra_action | heal_hp), none of which apply to 'you gain a subclass of your choice.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a Sorcerer subclass of your choice. The Draconic Sorcery subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Sorcerer levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Sorcerer level or lower.

notes: Identical structural gap as all other <Class> Subclass L3 features across every class (barbarian, bard, cleric, druid, fighter, monk, paladin, ranger, rogue, warlock, wizard). A new payload family is needed for one-time subclass selection / permanent progression grants that have no in-play activation, no consumable resource, and no combat-atom effect.
